# Agent Security & Document Intelligence

Paid x402 APIs for AI agents on Base Mainnet.

## Webpage Extractor
POST https://repoedu-1.onrender.com/web-extract
Price: $0.005 USDC
Input: {"url":"https://example.com"}
Purpose: fast clean webpage text, metadata and links for AI-agent research.

## Website Security Preflight
POST https://repoedu-1.onrender.com/site-audit
Price: $0.50 USDC
Input: {"url":"https://example.com"}
Purpose: live public website security preflight.

## Business Document Analyzer
POST https://repoedu-1.onrender.com/analyze
Price: $0.50 USDC
Input: {"text":"string"}
Purpose: deterministic structured extraction from business documents.

## Service design
Fast JSON responses, no API keys, no account setup, x402 payment per call, Base Mainnet USDC.

## Payment
x402 v2, exact scheme, eip155:8453, USDC.
Payee: 0x031a713863890eb611776aadd48397873ed153ab

## Discovery
Both routes advertise x402 Bazaar metadata and machine-readable schemas.
